title: In Modem, there is a possible out of bounds write due to an incorrect bounds check. (CVE-2026-20563)
description: A vulnerability in the Modem component allows an out of bounds write due to an incorrect bounds check. This flaw can be exploited remotely without user interaction if a user equipment (UE) connects to a rogue base station controlled by an attacker. Exploitation could lead to a denial of service condition.
